newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone threat to shipping off W.Australia.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone threat to shipping off W.Australia.

text.p: Tropical cyclone Phil, offshore to the north of West Australia is mainly a risk to shipping during the next 48 hours, Weather Services Corp said.
Top winds near the centre of the cyclone have dropped to 65 mph. It will track west-southwest and weaken this period, becoming less and less of a threat to shipping with time.
Earlier, a spokesman for West Australian Petroleum Pty ltd said the Barrow oil field offshore will not be forced to shut-in production due to the cyclone.
